crown.name: The Crown (the Halo)
crown.blurb: HALO’s orbital-lit apex: arcology penthouses, executive enclaves, real sky. A drawn pistol brings Aureole Security in seconds.
places: a sky-garden penthouse above the Solar Crown
an Obsidian Holdings private simsense salon
complications: Aureole Security runs a surprise protocol sweep of the level.
The target is live on a HALO feed — half the hive is watching.
A Radiant Concord benefit gala fills the level with cameras and clergy.

response.low: Aureole patrols tighten and every door on the level locks.
response.medium: An Aureole response squad arrives: Corp Security Officers under a Response Lieutenant.
response.high: A Contract Enforcer is dispatched with drone cover.
response.extreme: Full lockdown: Ironclad-grade security seals the level and the lifts stop.

support.label: An Obsidian Holdings concierge on the take
support.note: Sells guest credentials and service-lift schedules.
Can broker a clean identity to get in — at a price.

spires.name: The Spires
spires.blurb: Upper corp towers: research floors, trading vaults, and boardrooms above the smog line, all of it patrolled and logged.
places: a Caduceus research tower lab floor
a Kestrel Dynamics logistics control deck
complications: A shift change puts twice the guards in the lobby.
The tower’s host is running an audit — the Wired is watching every login.
A rival crew was hired for the same target tonight.

response.low: Floor security checks badges and the elevators slow down.
response.medium: A Response Lieutenant leads a corp security squad to the floor.
response.high: A Contract Enforcer arrives to close the file.
response.extreme: Ironclad contractors under an Ironclad Warden seal the tower.

support.label: A disgruntled facilities tech
support.note: Knows which service shafts skip the cameras.
Patches the crew afterward, no records.

grid.name: The Grid
grid.blurb: The hive’s wage-body: licensed commerce, patrolled corridors, artificial light. Order is real but rented.
places: a licensed noodle arcade over a data closet
complications: The Metermen want their cut before anyone works this corridor.
Warden Krael’s SIN-flag sweep is today — everyone’s ID gets checked.
A missed-payment eviction turns the corridor into an angry crowd.

response.low: A Metermen crew and the corridor cameras take notice.
response.medium: Corp Security Officers answer the call with a Response Lieutenant.
response.high: The corp sends a Contract Enforcer to clean it up.
response.extreme: Ironclad contractors lock down the level under an Ironclad Warden.

support.note: Can make a SIN flag disappear — or appear.

support.label: A Metermen corridor boss
support.note: Keys, access, and the name of whoever is behind on rent.

flats.name: The Flats
flats.blurb: Dense, dim, semi-lawless underlevels where gangs, fixers, and level-bosses fill the gap corp authority left. Most runs begin here.
places: a Ninth Ward Kings market block
a soup-kitchen block run as a congregation
complications: The Ninth Ward Kings demand a tax to work their turf.
Glass Vipers are filming the run for the feeds.
A Hollow Men block sits across the only exit.

response.low: Local crews notice and start asking questions.
response.medium: A Colors Boss rolls up with the crew.
response.high: The Gang Boss calls in every set on the block.
response.extreme: The Warlord answers — and the whole block answers with him.

support.note: Brokers peace with whichever gang owns the turf.
Offers sanctuary on her block — and asks questions later.

sinks.name: The Sinks
sinks.blurb: The sunless, half-flooded deep hive where Nyx’s Churn drifts and the Signal barely reaches. Nothing is illegal because nothing is enforced.
places: a drifting stall in Nyx’s Churn
a Ferrum foundation stair gone to rust
complications: The Signal drops out — no comms for the rest of the scene.
Floodwater rises through the lower level.
The Ferryman’s toll just doubled.

response.low: Scavengers and critters gather at the noise.
response.medium: A Veil cult cell takes an interest.
response.high: Something big wakes up in the silt.
response.extreme: The dark itself answers — Signal horrors climb toward the light.

support.note: Owns the crossings. Pay the toll.

support.label: A Churn broker for Nyx
support.note: Sells gear, maps, and bad news.

deadfall.name: Deadfall Nine (the Quiet Floor)
deadfall.blurb: Sublevel 9, walled off a generation ago. Sound thins, then signal, then thought. The closest surfaced wound of the Incursion in the Reach.
places: a dead-air chapel where sound goes thin
an abandoned transit platform past the wall
complications: Dead-air: comms fail and voices carry no distance.
A crew member hears their own name from the dark.
Ferrum Deepworks techs are patching the wall — and don’t want witnesses.

response.low: The quiet deepens; something notices the living.
response.medium: The emptied rise and walk toward warmth.
response.high: Something that used to be a crawler comes up from below.
response.extreme: The Incursion leans through: Signal horrors walk the floor.

support.note: The last friendly face before the wall.

support.label: A hidden-remnant Street Priest
support.note: Knows the prayers that still carry down here.

cinderhold.name: Cinderhold
cinderhold.blurb: The scrappy, half-free settlement at the Reach’s outer gate: cast-offs, exiles, and the closest thing to unowned ground in the campaign.
places: the salvage market under the gate arch
complications: Kestrel Dynamics surveyors are at the gate with contracts and clean water.
Raiders are testing the wall tonight.
Marrow bars the crew until they explain themselves.

response.low: The militia takes a hard look at the crew.
response.medium: Wasteland raiders strike while the gate is distracted.
response.high: Chrome Raiders hit the salvage market in force.
response.extreme: The wall alarm sounds — something vehicle-sized is coming.

support.note: Gives wasteland work; bars those who cross the settlement.

support.label: A Greenline Ranger contact
support.note: Seed, water-tech, and ammunition off the books.

wastes.name: Wastes – Outer Wall
wastes.blurb: Beyond the gate: poisoned wastes, dead cities, and the jungle past the Outer Wall. No security, no Signal, no rescue.
places: a dead city on the caravan route
a canopy trail beyond the wall
a reclaimed-ground survey marker gone quiet
complications: The wall alarm sounds — something big is moving.
The caravan route has gone quiet.
Poisoned weather forces the crew to shelter.

response.low: Scavenger beasts follow the crew’s trail.
response.high: Canopy predators start hunting the crew.
response.extreme: A Reach Behemoth comes out of the green.

support.note: Reads the ground better than anyone alive.

support.label: A Greenline Ranger scout
support.note: Knows which trails came back wrong.
